title: Time-series momentum on gold, 1/3/12-month lookbacks, monthly hold
source: Hurst, Ooi & Pedersen (2017), A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing, Journal of Portfolio Management 44(1)
why: Same rule as tsmom_hurst_fx applied to XAUUSD, which the paper's commodity set includes. Overlaps the rejected 20-futures TSMOM test (research/futures_tsmom.py) on the gold leg; this is a single-symbol sign rule with the paper's monthly hold, not the volatility-sized basket
